Two commits on `claude/project-thread-4rb1u8`: 87f02db9c (opener and roster keyed by seat) and c2792c090 (the reader's `To:` line, the two rules texts). Diff against the merge-base ddab8b996: six files, +348 −154.

### ① Derived judgments

Against the card's Wanted list, each read off the committed tree.

1. The key is the seat: correct. `seatKey` in `mailbox-open.mjs` reads `LANE#N` with the lane one of `domain:x`, `repo:x`, `triage`, `director`, lower-cased, an absent number spelled as 1 (`triage` reads `triage#1`), and refuses a login (`os-bill`, `marchtian`) and the shapes `ui 4`, `domain:ui#0`, `#4`, `domain:`. The branch is `mailbox/LOGIN/SLUG` with the slug the key as one ref segment (`domain:ui#4` becomes `ui-4`, `repo:cloud#1` becomes `repo-cloud-1`, `triage` becomes `triage-1`): `mailboxBranch(login, seat)`, self-tested, and `MAILBOX_BRANCH_PREFIX` itself unchanged at `mailbox/`.
2. The body opens `Mailbox-of: SEAT · LOGIN`: correct. `mailboxBody` writes it as the first line, the PR title becomes `pm:mailbox — SEAT · LOGIN`, and a self-test case feeds the opener's own `--head` body back through `mailboxOwner` and reads `{ seat: 'triage#1', slug: 'triage-1', login: 'os-bill' }`, which closes the writer/reader disagreement the PR body measured on main (opener wrote `To: LOGIN`, roster read `Mailbox-of:`). Messages open `To: SEAT`: correct. `readMailboxLine` now requires a `To:` line (after the one optional signature line) whose value `seatKey` accepts, then the key line; `to` is returned as the canonical key beside the key's own fields and never shadows a key's own `seat`.
3. `--seat` required: correct, `parseArgs` refuses an open without it (`--seat LANE#N is required to open a mailbox — the mailbox is the seat's, never the login's`), refuses a value that is not a seat, and refuses a seat whose branch would not be a legal ref; the CLI battery pins exit 2 for an open without `--seat`. The refusal is per seat: `openMailboxesOf(pulls, seat)` matches by slug, whichever login holds the mailbox; the battery shows seat 4 opening while seat 3 of the same login is open, each then finding only its own, and the same seat under another login still refused. `--close` unchanged: `planClose`, `closeRefusal` and `closeLive` are untouched; the one addition is a usage refusal of `--close` combined with `--seat`, which changes no close semantics.
4. The self-test covers two seats under one login, both opening: correct, the case `two seats under ONE login both open` (`domain:server#3` and `domain:server#4` under `os-elon-musk`), and the dev's mutation probe (match by login turns it red) is consistent with the case as written.
5. The roster reads a mailbox per seat row and flags a legacy per-login one: correct. `mailboxLogin` is deleted and replaced by the opener's `mailboxOwner` (imported, with a self-test that it is the same function); `buildRows` fills `mailbox` by `slug === seatSlugOf(row)` and never by account; `unassignedMailboxes` lists a legacy per-login mailbox (`legacy per-login, names no seat`) and a per-seat one no seat post carries (`no seat post carries this seat`), rendered under the table with a warning line and carried in `--json` as `unassignedMailboxes`. The fixture gains the per-seat body-on-`--head` shape (25392), head-slug with body (25393), head-slug only (25394), legacy `To: LOGIN` (25395) and a seat with no post (25396); the self-test pins three seats of `os-elon-musk` (devx#1, skills#2, repo:hotcrm#1) each showing only its own mailbox or none.
6. `project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉 and the PR body template say the same thing: correct. Both say one per seat keyed by the seat, opened at seating and subscribed by the seated session, never merged, owing no CI, excluded from ledgers, closed at hand-over or account switch with the successor opening its own, body first line `Mailbox-of: SEAT · LOGIN`, message first line `To: SEAT` and the key on the next line. The seven key lines of the forms text are untouched by the diff, `MAILBOX_KEYS` in the reader is untouched, and the self-test that every key template is spelled verbatim in the forms text and that the text lists exactly seven still passes. The hand-over steps name the close and the reopen: correct, `seat-post-protocol.md` step 9 now reads `关本席信箱(mailbox-open.mjs --close N),接任者坐席时按席重开;向维护者交最终报告`, folded into the existing line.
7. Unchanged as the card requires: `MAILBOX_LABEL` (`pm:mailbox`), `PR_LABELS` (`pm:mailbox`, `pinned`, `skip-changeset`), `LEDGER_EXCLUSION` (`-label:pm:mailbox`), the body's `Never merged, never readied` and `CI: owes none` lines, and the `--head` path (`planOpen` with `head` skips the push, `openLive` still checks `ahead_by` against the base). The diff touches none of their definitions.
8. The migration is left out of the diff: correct. Nothing in the tree closes or reopens #27523, #27357 or #27309; the PR body lists the migration as a card-thread follow-up and names the `refs/heads/mailbox/os-justin` deletion that must precede that account's first default-path open (confirmed: #27309's head is `mailbox/os-justin`; the opener's push-failure message now names the nested-ref refusal).
9. Callers of `mailboxLogin`: on this head nothing imports it; its two callers in `fleet-roster.mjs` (`buildRows`, `readLive`) are rewritten onto `mailboxOwner`, and `readLive`'s former two-part guard collapses to one because `mailboxOwner` is non-null for every labelled pull. Callers of `readMailboxLine` and `mailboxEvents`: none outside `record-recognisers.mjs` on this head (`check-owed-reviews.mjs` and `post-stamped.mjs` import other readers only), so no gate or patrol changes behaviour. The new edge `record-recognisers.mjs` imports `mailbox-open.mjs`: `mailbox-open.mjs` imports `invoked-as.mjs`, `fleet-write/validate.mjs` and `gh-pages.mjs`; `validate.mjs` imports `check-governed-merges.mjs`, which `record-recognisers.mjs` already imported on main, and none of them imports `record-recognisers.mjs`, so no cycle is added. The record-recognisers self-test (which drives the queue guard) ran to its verdict locally.
10. Skill text against its budgets: `project-forms.md` 54 lines on main and head (ceiling 54), `seat-post-protocol.md` 88 and 88 (ceiling 88); the ratchet, `check-skill-id-lint` (no `#NNN` added; `PR #n` placeholders stay legal) and `check-governed-prose` pass on the head.

### ② Semver level

No package is published by this diff (PM scripts and skill references only). `Clause-②: no` on the PR body, label `skip-changeset`, no changeset, Check Changeset green. Consistent; no level to declare.

### ③ Boundary flags

The author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so no relay note is owed.

- Tier: the register rows `.claude/**` as Tier S and triage wrote Tier H; the seat takes Tier H and the maintainer approves. Accepted, the stricter one.
- File surface amended before push (record-recognisers, the roster fixture, seat-post-protocol): the claim 6512908403 carries the amendment (updated 01:58Z, before the PR at 02:37Z), and the three additions are each forced by the keyed-by-seat change (`To: SEAT` broke the reader, the fixture carried the per-login shape, the hand-over steps live in seat-post-protocol). Accepted.
- Seat shape narrowed to four lane forms: `domain:x`, `repo:x`, `triage`, `director` are the four kinds `SKILL.md` names and `parseSeat` in the roster reads; every fixture and live seat post is one of them. Accepted, with should-fix 1 below on the second seat shape the reader still carries.
- No merge of main: main is now 8 commits past the merge-base ddab8b996 (the dev counted 7; da94c1133 landed since), and `git diff --stat merge-base..origin/main` over the six surface paths is empty. No conflict with the reviewed surface.
- `refs/heads/mailbox/os-justin` noted as a migration follow-up: confirmed as #27309's head; the opener refuses nothing because of it today (the push would fail after the read step, exit 3, nothing sent) and its message names the cause. Accepted as a follow-up, see should-fix 3.
- The doorbell vocabulary: unchanged, seven keys, verbatim in the forms text, self-tested.
- Legacy comments: every existing comment on the three legacy mailboxes is key-first with no `To:` line, so on this head `readMailboxLine` returns `refused` (`the first line is not To: SEAT`) for all of them, and a `To: LOGIN` line is refused as `names no seat`. Acceptable: no gate reads `mailboxEvents` (pinned by the self-test case that the queue guard's record reading is untouched), nothing else calls it on this head, the card itself rules that messages open `To: SEAT`, and the migration closes the legacy mailboxes. See should-fix 2.
- The two opener self-tests are wired to no CI job; run locally here, see Local-runs.

### ④ Design judgment

`project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉: the four rewritten lines hold against the tool that enforces them. The branch, the body's first line, the message's first and second lines and the close-at-hand-over rule are each what `mailbox-open.mjs` writes and `record-recognisers.mjs` reads, and the one convention the reader tolerates beyond the text (one leading signature line before `To:`) is the same tolerance the text already had before the key line. The forms text saying 键是席位 ⛔ 非账号 matches the refusal being per slug and the legacy per-login mailbox blocking nothing.

`seat-post-protocol.md` 〈交接收尾清单〉 step 9: the close names the exact command (`mailbox-open.mjs --close N`) and the reopen is the successor's at seating, which is what `mailboxBody` tells the reader and what 〈信箱 PR〉 says. Within budget, no line added.

The tooling as cited code: `mailboxOwner` is one reading used by the opener, the roster and the self-tests (body outranks head; head-only slug; legacy login with no seat; labelled pull naming neither reads as a mailbox of nobody, never a non-mailbox), which is the right shape for the roster to flag rather than attribute. `seatKey` is imported by the reader rather than re-spelled. The slug is one-to-one only while no `domain:` lane is named `triage`, `director` or `repo-…`, which the header states as a fact of the board rather than enforcing (should-fix 4). The dev's mutation probes correspond to cases present in the batteries.

Must-fix: none.

Should-fix (follow-up cards, none blocks landing):

1. `record-recognisers.mjs` now carries two seat shapes: `SEAT_REF` (the seat field of `Notify: seat-online`, `seat-offline` and `split`, accepting `skills#1` or any `word:x`) and the imported `seatKey` (the `To:` line, four lanes only). `Notify: split · skills#2 · …` under `To: skills#2` is refused on the envelope and read on the key. One shape, `seatKey`, for both would close the gap.
2. The migration card should say that the three legacy mailboxes' existing threads read as half-states on this head and are not to be re-read or re-sent, so no patrol files them as faults.
3. The migration card should carry the ordered steps the PR body gives for `os-justin` (close #27309, delete `refs/heads/mailbox/os-justin`, then open per seat) so the nested-ref refusal is not met cold.
4. `seatKey` could refuse a `domain:` lane named `triage`, `director` or starting `repo-`, making the slug's one-to-one claim enforced rather than stated.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：信箱从「每个账号一个」改成「每个席位一个」。`mailbox-open.mjs` 必须带 `--seat`，分支是 `mailbox/LOGIN/席位slug`，正文首行 `Mailbox-of: 席位 · LOGIN`，按席位拒重开（同账号的两个席位可以各开一个）。消息须在键行前写 `To: 席位`，`record-recognisers.mjs` 据此读出收件席位。`fleet-roster.mjs` 按席位行读信箱，旧的按账号信箱列为「未归属」，不再算到某个席位头上。`project-forms.md`〈信箱 PR〉与交接清单同步改写。6 个文件 +348/−154，其中规则文字 2 个文件，行数不变。
- 为什么改：平台一个 PR 的事件只送达一个会话，一个账号常坐多个席位（本账号就坐着 server 3、4 席和 skills 2 席），所以第二个席位永远收不到信。按维护者「同意，直接立卡按席位开信箱」。
- 风险与回滚：只改 PM 工具与规则文字，不碰产品代码，也不加门禁。现有三个按账号信箱（#27523、#27357、#27309）上的旧评论在新读法下判为 refused，它们由迁移卡 #27890 关闭并按席位重开。回滚即 revert。PR 正文末行「欠契约复审」已由本条接替。
- 先看：`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` 的 `seatKey` 与按席位拒重开一段，然后是 `record-recognisers.mjs` 的 `readMailboxLine`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --self-test` 与 `node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` 均 exit 0，其中包含「同一账号两个席位各开一个」的用例。
- 需要你做的：受管面规则改动，按分诊走 Tier H，请批准本 PR（契约复核 PASS 6513700361，`Head-sha: c2792c090212bea9fa9e5a1bb5cc3c2e19ff170f`）。

席位意见：ACCEPT。契约复核 PASS，无 must-fix；四条 should-fix 均为后续，已立 #27890（迁移）与 #27891（座位语法统一）。CI 全绿。

Tier H per triage 6501344388; the register's `claude-tree` row reads Tier S, so the seat takes the stricter.
- **前提实测:** on `origin/main` `mailbox-open.mjs` ① refused per login (exit 4) on the stated premise "a login holds one seat at a time", false on the live board (claim 6512908403); the roster read `Mailbox-of:` while the opener wrote `To:`, so cloud mailboxes were invisible to the roster — this diff aligns writer and reader (review ①).
